notes: Rankin Alley (12 ft) enters from sheet 61 at the west edge (y ~942); it is printed RANKIN west of Cutter and just 'ALLEY' east of Cutter, same line, to Smith Alley. Black Alley printed 'BLACK (MORGAN)' (10 ft), Kossuth to Cutter; east of Cutter an unnamed 10 ft alley continues the line (centre y ~1783 vs 1790) to Bickett Alley, so Cutter/Black is marked cross and the east leg is listed under alleys. O'Brion Alley printed 'O'BRION (McBRION) ALLEY' (10 ft), Kossuth to Cutter; east of Cutter only a narrow (~6 ft) unlabelled passage continues to Bickett Alley (listed under alleys), so Cutter/O'Brion is a T. Bickett Alley printed 'BICKETT ALLEY' (12 ft), Clark to Court at x ~2150. Church Court printed 'CHURCH CT. (MOUND ALLEY)' (12 ft), Clark to Court. Wesley printed 'WESLEY AV.' 52 ft. Smith Alley (12 ft, printed 'SMITH ALLEY') runs Hopkins to Clark at x ~3655 and Mound Street (47 ft) runs south from Clark at x ~3737-3745: they do not line up (about 80 px offset, different widths), recorded as separate T's at Clark. Chestnut and Elizabeth enter from the east (sheet 63/53 side) and end at Mound; their widths are not printed here (Chestnut measures ~40 ft, Elizabeth ~52 ft between block lines). Kossuth is narrower at the Court end (west line ~997 vs ~975 further north); point uses the water-pipe line and east line. Court Street centre drifts from y 4152 at Rittenhouse to 4194 at Mound while Clark stays ~1390; read as drawn. Street names printed without suffix (HOPKINS, CLARK, RITTENHOUSE, KOSSUTH, CUTTER, MOUND, CHESTNUT, ELIZABETH); 'Street' assumed.
